2  ORAL ORDER
The subject petition is preferred in the year 2023.
Long before the filing of the subject petition, it is an admitted fact that the charges were framed and trial is on for the last four years.
NC: 2026:KHC:11559 HC-KAR 2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that M.C. Petition filed by the petitioner No.1/husband has been allowed on the score of cruelty and therefore, this Court at this stage notwithstanding the fact that the trial is in advance stage, would entertain the petition.
3.
His submission is rejected.

4. The petitioners are at liberty to produce all the materials before the concerned Court and urge all the contentions that are urged before this Court, before the concerned Court at the appropriate stage.
5. With these observations, the petition stands disposed.
6. In view of disposal of the petition, pending I.As., if any, do not survive for consideration and the same stand disposed.
